thread:
ana: Draft ready for the product release blog — looking for a quickpass and a webinar routing plan. Posted a Google doc: https://go/release-blog-draft. Can people skim and flag claim issues by EOD? :pray:
matt: on it. quick q — are we using the 2.1x inference speed stat in the hero? need the benchmark owner to confirm numbers before we publish. @lisa?
lisa: yep, that 2.1x came from the internal test run 2025-03-12. i'll double-check numbers and add a short note in the doc about test harness and model/seq-len. if it's sensitive, we should soften to "~2x".
ben: design note — hero image needs to be 1200x630 for socials. i've got two variants, lean vs technical. will drop paths in the doc. prefer the technical one for launch. assets: `/assets/blog/product-release/hero-tech-v2.png`
sam: for webinar routing, recommend tagging registrants in HubSpot with `lp:release-2025` and putting them into the "launch-nurture-webinar" list. also push a high-intent segment to SDRs after 48 hrs. snippet for ops: ```hubspot: create-list name=launch-nurture-webinar filter=registrant_of_webinar:true tag=lp:release-2025```
matt: copy question — we have a line that says "cut inference costs by 40%". that's a big claim. where's the data? if we can't validate, change to "reduce per-token cost by up to 40% in some workloads".
lisa: agreed. i'll add a parenthetical about workload type and the test config: GPT-like decoder, 8k context, batch=16.
nana: (typo) sorry, meant @ana.
nana: also, quick reminder — legal needs to review any comparative claims. can we flag the lines for legal quickpass?
nana: pinging @matt @lisa to add an inline comment titled "legal-req" where needed.
ben: uploaded both hero variants to Figma and added a comment with file link. small request: can marketing pick the image by noon so design can finalize assets for the landing page?
matt: i'll pick by 11:30. leaning technical hero + a callout box for "benchmarks & methodology" link.
sam: webinar planning — who is moderating? need speaker blurb for the registration page and a 1-paragraph CTAs for the blog.
lisa: product to provide speaker blurb. @matt can you draft the blog CTA and the registration tagline? e.g., "See Redwood Inference in action — join our launch webinar".
matt: draft tagline: "See Redwood Inference in action — how we make inference predictable and economical." short CTA: "Register for the demo + benchmark walk-through". posting to doc now.
nana: (again meant @ana) please add the HubSpot UTM params for tracking — UTM_source=blog, UTM_campaign=release-2025, UTM_medium=organic
ana: also let's ensure the registration CTA on the blog hits `/webinar/release-2025?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=release-2025&utm_medium=organic`
publish-bot: Reminder scheduled — internal publish readiness check in 24 hours for thread 5155556789.
sam: routing checklist for ops: 1) hubspot tag `lp:release-2025` 2) send registrant list to SDR queue after 48 hrs 3) set webinar follow-up email with the benchmark deck link 4) create Zap to add registrants to intercom targeted campaign.
matt: tagging legal now and adding the claim-guard comments. can we do the legal quickpass today? if not, push publish out 24 hrs.
lisa: product can do a fast turn. i'll have confirmation on the benchmark wording and test config posted in the doc in 2 hours.
nana: thanks team — if legal ok and product confirms, we'll aim to finalize hero + CTAs by midday and schedule publish for 17:00 PT tomorrow. :rocket:
